card.name: Words inside all-caps label headings
card.fires_on: The second or later word of an all-caps heading or warning phrase, such as PRODUCT, MANAGEMENT, FAILURE or LEVEL. It fires in drug-label warning text written in capitals.

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: A noun finishing an all-caps warning phrase.
modes.example: WARNING: CONGESTIVE HEART<< FAILURE>> AND LACTIC ACIDOSIS

modes.label: All-caps instruction sentences
modes.description: A word early in an all-caps sentence like keep-out-of-reach or dosage text.
modes.example: WARNING KEEP THIS<< PRODUCT>> OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN

modes.label: Other capitalized headers
modes.description: Words in capitalized headings outside labels.

card.plain: It marks a word in the middle of a capital-letter heading, mostly in label warnings.
